title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Beat eggs and mix with grated cheese.
Drain pasta and combine quickly with eggs and pancetta off heat.
Season with black pepper and serve.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices.
Prepare sauce with tomatoes and cream.
Simmer chicken in sauce and serve with rice.

title: Avocado Toast
summary: Simple and healthy avocado toast with lemon and chili flakes.
steps: Mash avocado with lemon and salt.
Spread on toast and sprinkle chili flakes.
